extracted.name: Healthy porridge bowl
extracted.description: Start your day right with this filling bowl of oats, berries, banana and seeds. It's healthy and packed with nutrients to fuel body and mind
ingredient_lines: 1 orange ½ sliced and ½ juiced
instruction_lines: Tip half the raspberries and all of the orange juice in a pan. Simmer until the raspberries soften, about 5 mins.

Meanwhile stir the oats, milk and 450ml water in a pan over a low heat until creamy. Top with the raspberry compote, remaining raspberries, orange slices, banana, almond butter, goji berries and chia seeds.
